ORIGINS.Definition: the places or times where something first began

PRACTICAL JOKES.Definition: tricks played on people to make them look silly

ERA.Definition: a period of time in history

PRANK.Definition: a trick played on someone for fun

MASS MEDIA.Definition: ways of giving news to very large numbers of people, such as TV and newspapers

CIRCULATION.Definition: the selling and passing around of copies to readers

BROADCAST.Definition: sent out on TV or radio

BACKGROUND.Definition: information about a situation that helps you understand it

ALPINE.Definition: of the Alps, the high mountains of central Europe

HARVEST.Definition: an amount of crops gathered at one time

HARVESTED.Definition: cut and gathered as a crop

EXOTIC.Definition: unusual and from a distant country

RIDICULOUS.Definition: silly and not to be taken seriously

POP CULTURE.Definition: the music, TV, films and fashions that most ordinary people enjoy

PRESCRIPTION.Definition: a written note from a doctor that lets you get a medicine

INTRAVENOUS.Definition: going straight into the blood through a vein

PINT.Definition: a measure of just over half a litre, often used for beer in the UK

HIGHBROW.Definition: clever and aimed at educated people

LOWBROW.Definition: simple and aimed at people who want easy entertainment

ASTRONOMER.Definition: a scientist who studies the stars and planets

GRAVITY.Definition: the force that pulls things towards the Earth

MINION.Definition: one of the small yellow cartoon characters

FUNCTIONALITY.Definition: a feature that lets you do something

FUNERAL.Definition: a ceremony held after someone dies

SO-CALLED.Definition: called this by some people, often wrongly

FICTION.Definition: what is invented and not true
